::: {.panel-tabset}

## School Rosters

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)

# Read athlete data and sort by team, weight class, points
athletes <- read_csv("data/athletes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  arrange(team, weight_class, desc(points_scored), name)

# Helper function for place badges
get_place_badge <- function(place) {
  case_when(
    place == "1st" ~ '<span class="badge-gold">🥇 1st Place</span>',
    place == "2nd" ~ '<span class="badge-silver">🥈 2nd Place</span>',
    place == "3rd" ~ '<span class="badge-bronze">🥉 3rd Place</span>',
    place %in% c("4th", "5th", "6th", "7th", "8th") ~ sprintf('<span class="badge-place">%s Place</span>', place),
    TRUE ~ '<span class="badge-dnp">Did not place</span>'
  )
}

# Unique schools and seasons with rosters
schools <- sort(unique(athletes$team))
seasons <- sort(unique(athletes$season), decreasing = TRUE)

school_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', schools, schools),
  collapse = ""
)

season_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', seasons, seasons),
  collapse = ""
)

rows_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<tr data-team="%s" data-season="%s"><td><strong>%s</strong></td><td>%s</td><td><span class="badge-weight">%s lbs</span></td><td>%s</td><td><strong>%s</strong></td><td>%s</td><td><span class="badge-season">%s</span></td></tr>',
          athletes$team, athletes$season, athletes$name, athletes$team, athletes$weight_class, get_place_badge(athletes$place), athletes$record, athletes$points_scored, athletes$season),
  collapse = ""
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<div class="filter-card">',
  '  <div style="display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end;">',
  '    <div>',
  '      <label for="schoolSelect">Select a School</label>',
  '      <select id="schoolSelect" class="form-select" style="min-width: 280px; padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterSchoolRoster()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Schools (', length(schools), ' Programs)</option>',
  school_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div>',
  '      <label for="seasonSelect">Championship Season</label>',
  '      <select id="seasonSelect" class="form-select" style="min-width: 170px; padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterSchoolRoster()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Seasons</option>',
  season_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '  </div>',
  '  <div id="schoolRosterCount" style="margin-top: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #475569;">Showing all ', nrow(athletes), ' wrestlers</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="table-wrapper">',
  '<table id="schoolRosterTable" class="table table-hover">',
  '<thead><tr><th>Wrestler</th><th>School</th><th>Weight Class</th><th>Place</th><th>Record (W-L)</th><th>Points Scored</th><th>Season</th></tr></thead>',
  '<tbody>', rows_html, '</tbody>',
  '</table>',
  '</div>',
  '<script>',
  'function filterSchoolRoster() {',
  '  const selectedTeam = document.getElementById("schoolSelect").value;',
  '  const selectedSeason = document.getElementById("seasonSelect").value;',
  '  const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#schoolRosterTable tbody tr");',
  '  let count = 0;',
  '  rows.forEach(row => {',
  '    const matchTeam = (selectedTeam === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-team") === selectedTeam);',
  '    const matchSeason = (selectedSeason === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-season") === selectedSeason);',
  '    if (matchTeam && matchSeason) {',
  '      row.style.display = "";',
  '      count++;',
  '    } else {',
  '      row.style.display = "none";',
  '    }',
  '  });',
  '  const countEl = document.getElementById("schoolRosterCount");',
  '  if (countEl) {',
  '    countEl.textContent = (selectedTeam === "all") ?',
  '      ("Showing all " + count + " wrestlers") :',
  '      ("Showing " + count + " wrestlers for " + selectedTeam);',
  '  }',
  '}',
  'function makeTableSortable(tableId) {',
  '  const table = document.getElementById(tableId);',
  '  if (!table) return;',
  '  const headers = table.querySelectorAll("thead th");',
  '  headers.forEach((th, colIdx) => {',
  '    th.style.cursor = "pointer";',
  '    th.title = "Click to sort";',
  '    th.setAttribute("data-title", th.textContent.trim());',
  '    th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕";',
  '    let asc = true;',
  '    th.addEventListener("click", () => {',
  '      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");',
  '      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));',
  '      rows.sort((a, b) => {',
  '        const valA = a.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        const valB = b.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        const numA = parseFloat(valA);',
  '        const numB = parseFloat(valB);',
  '        if (!isNaN(numA) && !isNaN(numB)) {',
  '          return asc ? numA - numB : numB - numA;',
  '        }',
  '        return asc ? valA.localeCompare(valB) : valB.localeCompare(valA);',
  '      });',
  '      rows.forEach(r => tbody.appendChild(r));',
  '      headers.forEach(h => {',
  '        h.textContent = h.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕";',
  '      });',
  '      th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + (asc ? " ▲" : " ▼");',
  '      asc = !asc;',
  '    });',
  '  });',
  '}',
  'makeTableSortable("schoolRosterTable");',
  '</script>'
))
```

## All NAIA Schools

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

programs <- read_csv("data/naia_women_programs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  arrange(school)

HTML(paste0(
  '<p style="color: #475569; margin: 1rem 0; font-weight: 500;">Showing all ', nrow(programs), ' NAIA institutions sponsoring varsity women\'s wrestling programs.</p>',
  '<div class="table-wrapper">',
  '<table id="allSchoolsTable" class="table table-hover">',
  '<thead><tr><th>School</th><th>City</th><th>State</th><th>Conference</th></tr></thead>',
  '<tbody>',
  paste(
    sprintf('<tr><td><strong>%s</strong></td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td><span class="badge-weight">%s</span></td></tr>',
            programs$school, programs$city, programs$state, programs$conference),
    collapse = ""
  ),
  '</tbody>',
  '</table>',
  '</div>',
  '<script>',
  'makeTableSortable("allSchoolsTable");',
  '</script>'
))
```
